desc: First endpoint-scoped SPMI live proof. Boot only the ticket-092 R0 artifact. Runtime-assert exact J614s ADT/controller/sole-child/SID/right-port identity, issue one bounded SN201202x Register-0 selector for logical system-power-state 0x20, bounded selector poll, and one-byte extended data-window read. No WAKEUP/SLEEP/SHUTDOWN/SSPS, IRQ/event access, HPM application write, PHY/ATC/DWC3, USB/storage, fallback, retry escalation, or other SPMI controller/SID. DebugUSB stays left-back and passive stick stays right. Pass = expected ACKs plus one logged state byte and healthy proxy after reboot. Stop on any mismatch/timeout/leftover FIFO/SError. Exact artifact hashes and independent review required before approval.
